scope: Supplementary, region-focused public search across Asian, Indian, Russian and Canadian scholarly platforms after the 156-service attachment sweep.
evidence_boundary: A retained result is a source claim or repository fact, not a Poker Arena benchmark result. Empty or blocked searches are inconclusive. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, robots bypass or credential-bearing request was used.
query_families: poker OR Texas Hold'em OR Leduc
imperfect information OR reinforcement learning OR NFSP OR CFR
opponent modelling OR Bayesian player model
computer vision OR OCR OR calibration OR uncertainty
dataset OR code OR weights OR benchmark

platforms.name: J-STAGE
platforms.result: One directly relevant NFSP/Leduc paper and one historical rough-set/fuzzy seven-card-stud agent; no reusable weights or production dataset.

platforms.name: CiNii Research
platforms.result: Rediscovered Libratus and related global literature; index metadata did not add a new regional implementation.

platforms.name: ChinaXiv
platforms.result: Computer-vision, reinforcement-learning and calibration records were outside the poker/screen-reading domain.

platforms.name: KoreaScience
platforms.result: No high-signal poker record retained; this is not evidence of absence.

platforms.name: University of Alberta Computer Poker Research Group
platforms.result: CFR/CFR+, AIVAT, abstraction, opponent modelling and historical poker-agent evidence; formal two-player methods, not a drop-in multiplayer runtime.

platforms.name: MNI Open Research
platforms.result: Validation and decoder-uncertainty methodology only; no poker asset.

platforms.name: PHH v3 / University of Toronto record
platforms.result: Largest historical poker-hand collection found; the 21,605,687 human NLHE hands are anonymized logs from July 1-23, 2009.

platforms.name: HSE University Student Theses
platforms.access: Direct thesis record and full-text link
platforms.result: A 2025 bachelor thesis claims early LLM-enhanced poker results, but no pinned code, dataset, protocol or independently verified metrics were retained.

platforms.name: HSE University DDQN/DeepSeek thesis and public repository
platforms.access: Direct thesis record plus read-only static audit of the linked public GitHub repository
platforms.result: An open PyPokerEngine fork, DDQN checkpoint and logs exist, but the evaluation trains during testing, lacks deterministic seeds/duplicate deals, and the DDQN update retains only the last action of each hand. It is reproducible evidence of a prototype, not a promotable model.

platforms.name: CyberLeninka
platforms.access: Direct records and Russian-language site query
platforms.result: Generic RL/computer-vision/game-AI surveys; no poker model, dataset or reproducible benchmark retained.

platforms.name: Preprints.ru
platforms.result: Coverage inconclusive and never counted as an empty corpus.

platforms.name: IIT Kanpur course repository
platforms.result: Opponent hand-enumeration weights updated from observed raise/call/fold frequencies; no complete report, code, calibration or held-out result retained.

platforms.name: IIT Bombay R&D portal
platforms.result: Rummy-agent proposal combining Monte Carlo simulation and Bayesian opponent-hand prediction; no downloadable artifact or poker validation.

platforms.name: IIM Kozhikode working papers
platforms.result: Retrospective comparison of major poker bots; useful bibliography, no new algorithm, weights or dataset.

platforms.name: IndiaRxiv
platforms.access: Direct OJS page and public search
platforms.result: No narrow poker/vision artifact retained; not evidence that the repository contains none.

retained_findings.source_fact: The Leduc experiment separates exploration-originated actions from NFSP's supervised average-policy data and reports lower exploitability under fixed exploration.
retained_findings.inference: Behavior-policy provenance belongs in every replay row; exploration transitions should be a controlled exclusion ablation for NFSP only.
retained_findings.decision: Benchmark after the formal small-game adapter; do not transfer epsilon or performance numbers to NLHE.

retained_findings.source_fact: AIVAT is presented as an unbiased variance-reduction estimator and the paper reports 85% lower standard deviation in its HUNL match setting.
retained_findings.inference: It may reduce evaluation cost after explicit chance history, known-policy probabilities and a validated value estimate exist.
retained_findings.decision: Keep paired duplicate deals as control; add AIVAT only as a differential formal-lane challenger.

retained_findings.source_fact: The CPRG publishes the CFR+ implementation used for Cepheus and labels the source BSD-licensed.
retained_findings.inference: It is a useful independent reference for heads-up limit formal tests, not a rules oracle for custom multiplayer no-limit betting.
retained_findings.decision: Use only in an isolated, pinned reproduction if OpenSpiel differential tests leave a material gap.

retained_findings.source_fact: The public bachelor-thesis summary claims LLM-enhanced agents outperform traditional solvers at detecting and exploiting archetypes.
retained_findings.inference: Without immutable code, data, baselines, confidence intervals and leakage controls, the claim cannot support architecture or model promotion.
retained_findings.decision: Quarantine as a hypothesis; do not replace deterministic rules, calibrated policy outputs or the existing copilot.

retained_findings.source_fact: The linked repository was audited at commit 52fa10e7965e4351eb98a6532f67c38e4e50873e. It contains checkpoint SHA-256 687b16de0b41c967a9dec52c8ac37556955c9f4e48819e1fdee93979539fd2fa, an empty CFR notebook and a DDQN prototype whose replay records only the final action of each hand; training/evaluation are not separated and no seeds are fixed.
retained_findings.inference: The public code improves auditability over a thesis summary, but its last-action reward, stale target after checkpoint load, ineffective per-sample importance weighting, mutable online evaluation and unpaired seats/deals invalidate a direct performance transfer.
retained_findings.decision: Do not import the checkpoint, features or reported score. Retain the defect list as negative-test cases for the local grouped, paired and fail-closed evaluation pipeline.

retained_findings.source_fact: Student slides describe reweighting opponent hand enumerations from observed action frequencies.
retained_findings.inference: This is a historical Bayesian-frequency baseline, not evidence that fixed action counts are calibrated under position, street or temporal shift.
retained_findings.decision: The neutral Beta prior and held-out calibration remain safer; retain only as a baseline idea.

retained_findings.source_fact: The IIT Bombay record for granted Indian patent 554181 describes a Rummy agent combining Monte Carlo rollouts, Bayesian opponent-hand prediction and rule-based move selection; the page provides no downloadable weights, dataset or controlled poker benchmark.
retained_findings.inference: The modular decomposition is compatible with challenger experiments, but it neither establishes novelty for Poker Arena nor licenses a reusable implementation.
retained_findings.decision: No integration. Keep Monte Carlo and opponent inference separated and benchmarked; request an authorized artifact and patent/licensing review before any reproduction.

integrity_incidents.observation: Several site-delimited results under compromised-looking Indian academic subpaths contained unrelated casino/app-store SEO pages and unsupported AI/odds claims.
integrity_incidents.risk: Institutional-looking domains are not sufficient provenance; search-index poisoning can contaminate dataset discovery and literature receipts.
integrity_incidents.decision: Excluded all such pages, retained no claims or downloads, and require title-author-venue/artifact consistency before any academic-domain source enters the evidence set.

adopt_now: Record behavior-policy and exploration provenance in strategic training data.
Treat AIVAT as a future formal-lane variance-reduction benchmark.
Require modern authorized external holdout for any behavioral model trained on PHH human logs.
quarantine: HSE DDQN checkpoint with training/evaluation leakage and incomplete transition credit assignment.
Student-project parameters without code or held-out evaluation.
IIT Bombay patented Rummy architecture without an open artifact or poker benchmark.
